title: Set Up: What Do Earthworms Like?

scenes.tts: You need six to ten earthworms from your yard, a baking tray, paper towels, a cup of plain water, and cardboard to cover the tray.
scenes.narration: You need six to ten earthworms from your yard, a baking tray, paper towels, a cup of plain water, and cardboard to cover the tray.

scenes.tts: Line the tray with paper towels. Wet one half until damp, not puddled, and leave the other half dry. Cover the tray with cardboard. Lay the worms across the middle.

items.text: Wet one half, keep one dry

scenes.narration: Line the tray with paper towels. Wet one half until damp, not puddled, and leave the other half dry. Cover the tray with cardboard. Lay the worms across the middle.

scenes.tts: Cover the tray again. Wait ten minutes, then count the worms on each side. Expect most worms to end up on the damp side, but not every worm. Some barely move.

items.text: Most end up on damp side

scenes.narration: Cover the tray again. Wait ten minutes, then count the worms on each side. Expect most worms to end up on the damp side, but not every worm. Some barely move.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child the whole time. You lift any log or rock, and children stand back about six feet. Look at, but never touch, any snake.
